set.body: PRD V-9. Truth tables cover every Relation constructor and legal PairDesign inhabitant; tests distinguish canonical edge storage, mirrored endpoint reduction, and directed left and right reductions. Mutation checks prove participant or image projection removal, phase equality inversion, self-edge inclusion, cap-dependent priority derivation, and asymmetric comparison under canonical undirected evaluation are detected.
set.title: Relation truth tables and sampling mutation suite
